name: 分析（质量/内检/外检）控制

map.📖 查看「分析（质量/内检/外检）控制 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Assay (Quality/Internal Check/External Check) Control Guide"
map.相对偏差 RD = |基本分析值 − 检查分析值| ÷ 两者平均值 × 100%: Relative deviation RD = |primary assay − check assay| ÷ their mean × 100%; RD not exceeding the allowed limit (default 5%) is considered acceptable.
map.内检合格率 = 未超差项数 ÷ 检查项数 × 100%；按质量管理惯例，合格率: Internal-check acceptance rate = number of items within tolerance ÷ number of checked items × 100%; by quality-management convention, an acceptance rate ≥ 90% marks the whole batch as acceptable.
map.工具为纯前端统计，逐样品计算偏差并列出超差项，便于定位需复检的样品。: The tool is a client-side statistic that computes the deviation sample by sample and lists the out-of-tolerance items, making it easy to locate samples needing re-check.
map.检查数据（每行「样品编号,基本分析值,检查分析值」）: Check data (each line "sample ID,primary assay,check assay")
map.📚 深度解析：化验质量内检与外检控制: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Internal and External Check Control of Assay Quality
map.化验批次质量抽查: Quality spot-check of an assay batch
map.内检重复分析偏差评估: Deviation assessment of internal-check replicate analyses
map.相对偏差 RD = |A−B| ÷ [(A+B)÷2] ×100%；内检合格率: Relative deviation RD = |A−B| ÷ [(A+B)÷2] ×100%; internal-check acceptance rate = number of items within tolerance ÷ number of checked items ×100%. Out of tolerance means RD greater than the allowed limit.
map.S-01 12.5/12.1、S-02 8.4/8.9、S-03 20.0/19: S-01 12.5/12.1, S-02 8.4/8.9, S-03 20.0/19.2 with an allowed limit of 5% → RD are 3.25%, 5.78% and 4.08%, mean 4.37%; 1 item out of tolerance, acceptance rate 66.67%, judged unacceptable.
map.合格率多少才算合格？: What acceptance rate counts as acceptable?
map.批次合格率 ≥90% 判为合格，超差项需复检并查明原因；低于 90% 时应扩大抽: A batch acceptance rate ≥90% is acceptable; out-of-tolerance items must be re-checked and the cause found; below 90% the spot-check proportion should be increased.
map.允许限怎么确定？: How is the allowed limit set?
map.按分析方法与含量水平在质量管理规范中查表，高含量常用 5%，低含量可放宽到 10: Look it up by analysis method and content level in the quality-management code; 5% is common for high content, and low content can be relaxed to 10%-20%. The tool allows you to set it yourself.
